strengths_deep_dive: Bloom Charity Nfp demonstrates exceptional financial commitment to direct service, achieving a <cite id="1">98.7% program expense ratio</cite> in FY2024. Operating with minimal overhead allows nearly every dollar raised to support children facing trauma. Their ground intervention combines immediate emergency aid, such as <cite id="6">700,000 meals distributed in Gaza</cite>, with sustained early childhood support through play infrastructure. The charity has built over <cite id="6">11 PlayGardens</cite> and created therapeutic tools, including <cite id="10">trauma-informed care manuals</cite> for orphanages and local partners.
rich_narrative.summary: Bloom Charity Nfp is a dedicated nonprofit established in <cite id="1">2015</cite> that delivers critical early childhood development, trauma-informed care, and crisis intervention for vulnerable children and orphans. The organization focuses primarily on building specialized PlayGardens and providing essential aid across crisis zones and underserved areas, including Morocco and Gaza. In FY2024, the organization experienced early-stage growth with <cite id="2">total revenue reaching $551,810</cite>, up from $158,297 in FY2023. Bloom Charity operates with extreme financial efficiency, maintaining a <cite id="1">98.7% program expense ratio</cite> and directing maximum resources straight to direct beneficiary services. Their emergency mobilization in recent years has supplied over <cite id="6">700,000 meals in Gaza</cite> while expanding long-term infrastructure like play spaces that support mental and physical health. The organization holds a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite> and an overall rating of <cite id="1">89.5 out of 100 from Charity Navigator</cite>.
